title: Tiered reference corpus and gated re-eval process for config & model changes
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: Build a maintainable, permissioned reference corpus (tiered exemplars) and a policy-driven re-eval orchestration so configuration changes, model swaps, or quantization/precision updates automatically trigger appropriately-scoped quality checks before rollout.

Problem statement: Today we run broad re-evals manually or with monolithic golden sets that are slow, brittle, and expose sensitive prompts to wide groups. This results in either too many false alarms for low-risk config tweaks or missed regressions for high-risk changes. We need finer grain control over which examples run, who can modify them, and how results gate rollouts.

Key ideas:
- Tiered reference corpus: define three tiers (SMOKE, STRATA, AUDIT) mapped by change sensitivity. SMOKE = ~200 high-impact sanity checks for fast canaries; STRATA = 2–5k stratified samples for nightly/rate-limited re-evals; AUDIT = archived authoritative exemplars (immutable snapshots) for compliance and postmortem.
- Metadata per exemplar: sensitivity score, owner (curator), tags (feature/domain), last_revised, version, and linked-change-signature allowing us to compute a minimal subset impacted by a config diff.
- ACL roles: curator (can add/edit within STRATA), steward (approve SMOKE and STRATA promotions), auditor (read AUDIT only), maintainer (rotate/expire examples).
- Policy-driven gating: map change types (model swap, quantization, kernel switch, config flag flips) to tiers and thresholds. Low-risk config flips run SMOKE; high-risk model or config affecting tokenization run STRATA+A/B canary.
- CI/Orchestration: integrate with change CI such that PRs touching serving/runtime/configs automatically request a re-eval job with the right tier and report to the rollout dashboard.

Scope: define schema for exemplar metadata and ACLs, implement tier selection rules, create curator UI flows in Console for proposing/promoting examples, wire re-eval orchestration to our existing eval runner, and define SLAs for re-eval completion and alerting.

Out of scope for this ticket: metrics visualization polish, final audit retention policy (will be follow-up), integration with external vendor vaults for example storage.
acceptance_criteria: Reference corpus schema documented and stored in Confluence with examples
ACL role definitions and a mapping matrix to Console permissions reviewed and approved by Security
CI hook that triggers SMOKE re-evals on config PRs is implemented and green in staging
Re-eval job can select subset by change-signature metadata and complete within target SLA for SMOKE (15m) and STRATA (4h)
Regression alerting rules mapped to thresholds and wired to the rollout dashboard (muteable by stewards)
tasks: Write Confluence spec: reference corpus schema and tier definitions
Design Console flows for curator proposals and steward approvals
Implement change-signature extractor in config CI
Extend eval-runner to accept tier selectors and return differential delta metrics
Add ACL checks in the corpus API and integrate with SSO groups
Create SMOKE CI job and hook it into PR gating for runtime/config repos
Define runbook for steward reviews and emergency rollback path

2026-03-04 -- Liam O'Connor: Eng proposal posted (see links). Prototype change-signature extractor finds a small subset for ~70% of config diffs — promising but needs stronger heuristics for non-deterministic kernel flags.
2026-03-06 -- Design review: Console wireframes accepted with minor copy changes; curator flow will use 'propose' -> 'steward approve' to reduce blast radius.
2026-03-09 -- Security review: flagged requirement to encrypt AUDIT-tier exemplars at rest with KMS and restrict export. Added to tasks.

2026-03-11 -- Eng update: SMOKE CI job merged in staging (PR: github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/487). Running nightly; latency target met ~12m median. Working on STRATA parallelism to hit 4h SLA.
2026-03-12 -- PM note: Need decision on rotation cadence for STRATA (quarterly vs rolling reservoir). Proposing a rolling reservoir with TTL 180 days; soliciting feedback from data quality and legal.
